tokenize_corpus_function: tokenize a JSONL corpus file using GPT-2 tokenizer and save tokenized documents as a NumPy array
run_gpt2_dataset_builder: run the script with a data path and shard number to build a GPT-2 dataset from OpenWebText shards
tokenize_openwebtext_shard: tokenize an OpenWebText shard file into GPT-2 tokens and save the result as an .npy file
review_tokenize_corpus: review the tokenize_corpus function to understand how it parses JSONL lines and handles tokenization errors
refactor_print_interval: refactor the tokenize_corpus function to make the print interval configurable via command-line arguments
